nary_nodes.label: Approval of 13 settlements
evidence: Israel’s Security Cabinet has approved a plan to establish 13 new settlements in the central occupied West Bank, a move Palestinian officials say will further fragment the territory and isolate East Jerusalem from its surrounding Palestinian communities.

Israel’s Channel 7 reported that the cabinet approved the construction of the illegal settlements on Thursday in the Binyamin regional area, one of the largest settlement blocs in the occupied West Bank.

nary_nodes.label: Warning of fragmentation
evidence: Palestinian officials say will further fragment the territory and isolate East Jerusalem from its surrounding Palestinian communities.

Israel’s Security Cabinet has approved a plan to establish 13 new settlements in the central occupied West Bank, a move Palestinian officials say will further fragment the territory and isolate East Jerusalem from its surrounding Palestinian communities.

nary_nodes.label: Governorate statement on plan
evidence: The Jerusalem governorate said the scheme is designed to link settlement blocs, tighten Israeli control over strategic hilltops and restrict Palestinian territorial continuity.

“The plan seeks to create new geographical realities on the ground,” the governorate added in a statement, warning that the expansion would “undermine the prospects of establishing a geographically contiguous Palestinian state.”

nary_nodes.label: Accusation of escalation
evidence: It described the measures as “a dangerous escalation” and “violations of international law,” calling on the international community to intervene.

nary_nodes.label: Link to domestic politics
evidence: The governorate linked the acceleration of settlement activity to domestic political calculations in Israel, particularly with Knesset elections approaching.

nary_nodes.label: Report on outpost numbers
evidence: New data from the Palestinian Forum for Israeli Studies (MADAR) shows that the number of new settlement outposts has soared in recent years. After averaging approximately eight outposts annually between 2012 and 2022, the number jumped to 32 in 2023, then 62 in 2024, reaching 86 during 2025.

nary_nodes.label: Warning on two-state solution
evidence: Palestinian officials have long warned that continued settlement expansion is eroding the viability of a two-state solution, as more than 700,000 Israeli settlers now live in the West Bank and East Jerusalem territory Israel captured in the 1967 war.
